name: generate_image
description: Generate an image from a text prompt, or pass reference_images for image-to-image. Returns the local path of the result. Delivery differs by host: follow the assistant_instruction field in the result — local sessions show the image automatically, messaging platforms need send_message_to_user. On messaging platforms a reference must be an image attached this turn, a context_image_N from the history, or a trusted avatar URL.

reference_images.description: Same forms as vision_analyze's image: a local path, an http(s) image url, or a context_image_N.
